spine.entity: one OTMR event from a routine download: a brake application on the approach to a signal at caution or danger, or a TPWS brake demand

world.geography: England (a fictional regional train operating company, route, stations and signals)
world.org_type: a regional train operating company running diesel units on a main line and a branch

driver: Each event is judged against what a unit could have achieved, read from the fleet's rating on a reference condition, when every place sets its own achievable level and only the other units' routine records at that place show it; judged against the rating, the place whose own conditions hold every unit below the rating books the operators' late responses there to the conditions of the moment, and the place whose events lead under the rating is not the one whose operators responded late most often.
driver_concrete: Each 2024-2026 SPAD is the driver's when, from where braking began, a full-service application could not have stopped the train at the signal, judged at the deceleration full service achieves on that signal's approach in the routine OTMR approach events, not at the fleet's level-track rating; on the falling-gradient approach every train achieves about 0.68 metres per second squared against the rated 0.88, so its late-braking SPADs read as poor adhesion against the rating.
stump: A competent solver tests each SPAD at the fleet's rated full-service deceleration, books the falling-gradient signal's SPADs to poor adhesion because their trains decelerated at about 0.68 against the rated 0.88, and sends the package to the level junction signal; the step that lands it there is using the level-track rating on an approach whose own routine stops show every train achieving about 0.68 in dry weather, so the late braking there is the drivers'.

differentiation.task191: task191 architecture 3 rated bus depots on warnings whose trigger was real, an exposure denominator over fixed structures; task183 v3 rates no exposure and catches no artefact: each SPAD's braking is judged at the deceleration its own approach permits, which the routine stops there measure
differentiation.task186: task186 tests a unit's change against the shared cycles of its place (a noise model for a change); task183 v3 has no change and no null: each event is judged against the physical braking performance its place permits
differentiation.task308: task308 values a capacity offer by the shortfall it would remove when units of its kind fail together from one shared cause, so their rated availability overstates them in the hours that matter (a correlated-availability correction to a forward valuation); task183 v3 values nothing and corrects no availability: each past SPAD is classed by whether full service could have stopped the train from where braking began, at the deceleration its own approach permits, which the routine stops there measure

lineage.architecture: v1 (Tamsin Valley Electric's underground cable program: which of eight feeders fails most in 2027, from each section's own failure history)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-22 on measurement at the rework, never by a portal result (delivered 2026-10-12, pending review, left as delivered): the decisive step is reachable by one group-by on section_id, which names the call at an infinite lead in 300 of 300 swept world settings, and the designed forecast is linear in the in-service stock counts (regression on the twice-failed count alone R-squared 0.8180); re-rooted 2026-11-02 to architecture 2 in a new world, dataset and shell
lineage.niche: an electric distribution utility's underground cable program naming the one feeder whose worst sections it replaces in 2027, by the cable failures each feeder's in-service sections will have next year, when a first failure seldom recurs and a section that has failed twice keeps failing
lineage.driver: When a unit's coming events arise in its parts and a part that has already failed more than once keeps failing at many times the rate of a part with one or no failures, both the unit's trailing event rate and any rate built from its parts' visible attributes miss that the forward count is driven by the current mix of its parts' own failure histories; only a forecast that carries each part's prior failures forward names the unit with the most events ahead.
lineage.stump: A competent solver averages each feeder's last five years of cable-condition failures on the sections still in service and files Mill Lane 7 (about 14.4 a year against Quarry Hill 21's 10.4, fifth of eight), or applies failure rates by insulation and age and files Sutter Park 5; the step that lands it there is forecasting from feeder history or visible attributes when a section's next failure depends on how often it has already failed, and only Quarry Hill 21 carries in-service sections that have failed twice or more (17, heading 2027 at about 15 expected failures).
lineage.why: The correcting quantity was one per class (four pooled rates by prior-failure count), forced from the same file at the same grain as the main file, so a count of rows by section_id carried it; the re-root needs a correcting quantity one per case, forced by a second file at a finer grain, with no group-by on any shipped key reaching the call.

lineage.architecture: v2 (a Nebraska city electric department's January 2027 patrol of Feeder 14, the line recloser's 2026 trips relocated through the main line's segment impedances)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-02 at stage 4: the determinism judge returned DETERMINISTIC with SEND_BACK on Gate G (cut a11364ba): the shipped DMS fault-location log, the system's own per-trip estimate of where each trip came from, located the 24 trips in section 9 on a model carrying one conductor's impedance over the whole main line, and refuting it was the stump (planted_defect_flip, surface_read_rejection, sole_data_defect yes); dropping or correcting the log leaves the decisive step a textbook relocation, so the architecture and its world are spent; re-rooted the same day to architecture 3 in another client domain, world, dataset and shell
lineage.niche: a city-owned electric department locating what kept tripping its longest rural feeder's line recloser through 2026, for the one main-line section its January 2027 patrol walks, when the recloser's own fault locator carries the first conductor's impedance over a main line whose conductor changes partway out
lineage.driver: A device records where each event arose by a calculation that assumes the line is uniform along its whole length, every check on file falls in the stretch where it is, and beyond a change in the line's make-up the calculation overshoots, so the place the events cluster in the device's record is not where they arise; only re-deriving each event's position from its raw measurement through the line's actual make-up, segment by segment, finds it.
lineage.stump: A competent solver maps the recloser's fault-locator distances onto the main-line sections and sends the January patrol to the section where the 2026 trips cluster in that record, about two miles beyond the fault; the step that lands it there is trusting a single-impedance locator, validated only on faults inside its first conductor, on a main line whose conductor changes partway out.
lineage.why: The decisive step was carried by a shipped estimate of the decision quantity (the DMS locator's per-trip distance) that was wrong; without it the field's own method (relocation through the GIS segment impedances) is the opponent's first move, so the default path has to be the analyst's own easy method on correct records and the field's method has to sit at the bottom of the ladder.

notes: Anomaly Detection & Diagnostics: a real driver-error SPAD hotspot separated from SPADs that read as adhesion against the fleet rating. Stump strategy other, named here: an achievable-performance reference taken per place from the place's own routine record rather than from the fleet's rating. Gap objective: the fleet's rated deceleration is correct for level track and is not what decides a SPAD's class on a falling approach. G14 decisive (the pooled fleet rate does not apply to this approach), G3 (the rated against the operated), G16 (the method the records entitle).
